Amendment comment:
This is to amend the Managers' Transactions notification issued on 30 October
2023 with regard to the person subject to the notification requirement. The
shares specified in the notification were acquired not in the name of Esa
Kiiskinen but in the name of an entity jointly controlled by Esa Kiiskinen and a
related party to him.
